description: Python package, experiments, tests, firmware decision module, downloaded climate series (NASA POWER, CHIRPS) and all simulation outputs of the article on cistern-aware autonomous drip irrigation for semi-arid family farms (probe field model, relaxation-oscillator readout, FAO-56 water balance, stochastic dynamic programming policy tables, energy and cost analysis). Code under MIT, data and results under CC BY 4.0.
